meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把口播或访谈视频加上随字幕同步的图形卡片,原片画面保持不动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有口播或访谈素材,想加同步图形卡但不想动原画面。
copy.tagline_en: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to your talking-head video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have talking-head footage and want graphic cards fast

howto.what: 给已有的口播、访谈或播客视频叠加按转写时间对齐的设计图形卡片(标题、下三分之一、数据卡、引用卡等),原片画面保持不变,渲染成 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 的 MP4。
howto.when: 当你说 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 等关键词,或要求给现有视频做图形包装时触发;普通字幕走 /embedded-captions,意图不清先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我把这段访谈视频加上图形浮层,输出 9:16
say.note: 卡片时间按转写文本对齐

say.text: 用数据卡和引用卡把这期播客视频包装一下
say.note: 卡片数量由片长和密度推断

say.text: 把这段口播做成 16:9 的图形包装版

howto.what_en: Layers timed, designed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, etc.) onto an existing talking-head/interview/podcast video, synced to the transcript, and renders MP4 in 16:9, 9:16 or 4:5. The clip plays untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "graphic overlays" or "on-screen graphics", or when asked to package/dress up an existing video. Plain subtitles go to /embedded-captions; unclear intent to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add graphic overlays to this interview video, output 9:16
Package this podcast video with data callouts and quote cards
say_en.note: Card count inferred from length and density

say_en.text: Make a 16:9 graphic-packaged version of this talking-head clip
